title: ISC — Weekly KPI Digest
description: Triggers when ISC fires the schedule.weekly_kpi_digest webhook every Monday. Formats KPI data into an HTML email and sends it to the client via Gmail.

settings.note: Copy the generated Catch Hook URL and paste it into ISC → Admin → Integration Hub → Webhooks with event 'schedule.weekly_kpi_digest'. ISC fires this every Monday at 08:00 UTC — no Zapier schedule trigger needed.
Converts the KPI array into individual line items that can be iterated in the email body. Alternatively, use Code by Zapier (step 3) to build the full HTML table.
Replace YOUR_ISC_DOMAIN in the code above.

settings.subject: Your Weekly KPI Digest — Week of {{1__data__weekOf}}
settings.note: Connect your Gmail account. The HTML body comes from the Code step output.

setupSteps: 1. In Zapier, create a new Zap and choose 'Webhooks by Zapier' as the trigger with event 'Catch Hook'.
2. Copy the Catch Hook URL and register it in ISC → Admin → Integration Hub → Webhooks with event 'schedule.weekly_kpi_digest'.
3. Add a 'Code by Zapier' action (Run Javascript) and paste the code from step 3 of this file.
5. Add a Gmail action. Connect your account. Set body to the output of the Code step.
6. ISC fires this webhook every Monday automatically — no Zapier schedule trigger needed.
